notes: The panel starts again by itself when an update brings new panel code (no need to restart iCUE).
If the panel had to use its built-in copy, it switches back to Control Hub's newest one by itself.
Help → Copy details shows which panel version really runs, and what didn't load.
iCUE opens the widget once with this update: click to update it there.
From 1.3.0: Sound and Power pop-outs, icon-only buttons, the game keeps the focus when you touch the panel.
